hero.title: Our Story
hero.subtitle: Discover the essence of Eastin Hotel Madhapur

story.title: A Legacy of Luxury and Hospitality
content: Established in 2022 with a vision to redefine luxury hospitality in Hyderabad, Eastin Hotel Madhapur has quickly become a prestigious destination for discerning travelers. Our journey began with a simple yet profound commitment: to create a sanctuary where guests experience the perfect harmony of opulence and comfort.

Located in the heart of Hyderabad's thriving IT corridor, our hotel stands as a testament to architectural elegance and thoughtful design. Every aspect of Eastin Hotel has been meticulously crafted to offer an environment where business efficiency meets relaxation, and where traditional hospitality embraces modern luxury.

We take pride in our attention to detail – from the carefully selected artwork adorning our walls to the premium amenities in each room. Every element has been chosen to enhance the guest experience and create memorable stays.

facilities.title: Our Facilities
facilities.subtitle: Designed for comfort, convenience, and memorable experiences

items.title: 96 Luxury Rooms
items.description: Our hotel features 96 elegantly appointed rooms and suites, each designed with your comfort in mind.

items.title: Indoor Banquet Hall
items.description: A sophisticated venue accommodating up to 150 guests, perfect for corporate events and celebrations.

items.title: Executive Boardroom
items.description: A state-of-the-art boardroom equipped with modern technology for meetings of up to 30 people.

items.title: Open-Air Banquet Space
items.description: A stunning outdoor venue that can host up to 300 guests for weddings and grand celebrations.

items.title: Rooftop Party Space
items.description: An exclusive private party area with panoramic city views, ideal for intimate gatherings.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To consistently deliver exceptional experiences by combining luxurious accommodations, impeccable service, and thoughtful amenities that exceed the expectations of our guests. We strive to be the preferred choice for both business and leisure travelers visiting Hyderabad, creating lasting memories through personalized hospitality.

team.title: Leadership Team
team.subtitle: Meet the people behind Eastin Hotel's exceptional service

members.name: Arun Kapoor

members.name: Priya Sharma
members.bio: Priya oversees the day-to-day operations of the hotel, ensuring that every department functions seamlessly to deliver on our promise of luxury and comfort.
